source.title: Appointment of a new WCA Ethics Committee Leader (July 2019)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Ethics Committee Leader, as Walker Welch recently stepped down as the Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee. We would like to thank Walker the work he has done leading the Committee. In the interim period, the WCA Board will lead the Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Clear background
- Trustworthiness
- Independence
- Accountability

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents **until July 23rd, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).** 

<!-- break -->

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WEC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC are copied from [WCA Motion 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf) in the appendix below.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会新负责人招募（2019 年 7 月）
translation.content:
Walker Welch 近期卸任 WCA 道德委员会负责人，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Walker 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。过渡期间，委员会将由 WCA 董事会领导。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会事务。我们希望申请人具备：

- 背景清白。
- 值得信任。
- 能独立判断。
- 有责任心。

申请现已开放，**请于 2019 年 7 月 23 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）**。

<!-- break -->

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WCA 道德委员会负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WEC 的权利与职责摘自 [WCA 议案 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)，见下方附录。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 [WCA 议案 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。
notes: 原文提到“下方附录”，但本篇正文未附相关内容；仅保留原句与议案链接。
